jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(5)(D) inventory: Windham School District, a town school district in the Windham Central Supervisory Union (member town: Windham). Operates PK-6; for grades 7-12 Windham is a member of the West River Modified Union Education District (built in batch 11).
